correctness.rationale: PASS: The Galois closed sets are empty, singleton points, individual triple blocks and all points. Hence every pair is pseudo-intent; any larger pseudo-intent must close all contained pairs and thus be a proper subsystem; minimal proper nontrivial subsystems are exactly the surviving higher pseudo-intents. In characteristic two subsystem closure is equivalent to vector-subspace closure. Independent bitmask enumeration checked 21 pseudo-intents in the Fano plane, 36 in affine STS(9), and 120 in PG(3,2), including 15 Fano subspaces. Minor source proof slip: divisibility of w(w-1) by 6 ALONE does not exclude w=4,6, contrary to prose; the required r=(w-1)/2 integrality excludes even w, while w=5 fails 6 divisibility. This standard missing observation is sufficient and does not affect the theorem.
